name: peaqos
description: Onboard machines and fleet operators to peaqOS — peaq's financial OS for autonomous machines — using the peaq-os-cli Python CLI. Handles machine registration, peaqID creation, Machine NFT minting, Machine Credit Rating (MCR) setup, event submission, fleet management, and the full Scale / Machine Market flow (market onboarding, AI-agent pairing, service search, order placement, and dispute resolution). Works on both agung testnet and mainnet. Adapts to developers and non-technical operators alike.

cli_dependency.notes: Scale / Machine Market commands require a CLI release that ships the `scale` command group. If `peaqos scale --help` fails, upgrade with `pip install --upgrade peaq-os-cli`.
